description: Land Title Settlement Department - calling for claims to property of intestate in Ulpatha Kumbura, Four Gravets and Gangawata Koralaya D/S Division, Kandy District - Cad. Map No. 320308 and to 06 other properties
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land and property matters, specifically notices calling for claims to intestate property under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed land registration information including parcel numbers, land extents, cadastral maps, and certificates of title. The content focuses on property ownership transfers and land title registration processes, which falls squarely under the Land Gazette classification (Type 4). There are no government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories present.
